validation.mobile: Enter a valid Egyptian mobile number, e.g. 01012345678 (or an international number with its country code).
validation.phone: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. 01012345678 or 0223456789.
validation.email: Enter a valid e-mail address, e.g. name@company.com.
validation.duration: Enter the duration in minutes as a number (e.g. 5 or 2.5), up to 1440.

forms.leadLocked: This lead cannot be edited at its current stage (for example while it is handed off to Sales, or when another person owns that stage).
forms.notEditable: You can view this record but not change it.
forms.callNeeds: Choose an outcome and link the call to a customer, lead or opportunity to save it.
forms.meetingNeeds: Enter a subject, choose the customer and set the date and time to save the meeting.
forms.visitNeeds: Choose the customer and set the date and time to save the visit.
forms.callNeedsLead: Choose the lead this call was about.

savedViews.deleteMessage: “{name}” will be removed for everyone it is shared with. The records themselves are not affected.

dashboard.emptyFavorites: Star a customer, lead, opportunity, contract or project to keep it here.
dashboard.emptyRecent: Records you open will appear here.

calls.noSummary: No summary was recorded for this call.

performance.title: Performance & activity

performance.noActivity: No activity recorded in this period.

users.directorySubtitle: Employees and their roles. Open a person to see their performance and recent activity.

approvalLimits.title: Approval limits
approvalLimits.subtitle: The numbers the approval matrix uses: who approves which discount, margin, payment terms and contract value, and how fast.
approvalLimits.readOnly: Your role can view this value but not change it.

errors.integer: Enter a whole number of hours.

discounts.title: Discount authority
discounts.description: The largest discount each approver may grant. Above the Sales Manager ceiling the CFO approves; above the CFO ceiling, the CEO.

margins.title: Margin and payment terms
margins.description: Proposals below the margin floor go to the CEO; a down payment below the minimum goes to Finance.

values.title: Value thresholds
values.description: Contracts above the CEO threshold need the CEO; financial proposals above the Finance threshold need Finance validation.

timing.title: Response time
timing.description: How long an approver has to decide, and how early they are reminded.

help.approval_discount_salesManagerMaxPct: Discounts up to this percentage are approved by the Sales Manager.
help.approval_discount_cfoMaxPct: Discounts up to this percentage are approved by the CFO; anything higher by the CEO. Cannot be lower than the Sales Manager ceiling.
help.approval_marginFloorPct: A proposal with a margin below this needs the CEO.
help.approval_paymentTerms_minDownPaymentPct: A down payment below this needs Finance approval.
help.approval_contract_ceoAboveValue: Contracts and proposals above this value need the CEO.
help.financialProposal_financeValidationAbove: Financial proposals above this value need an extra Finance validation.
help.approval_slaHours: Hours an approver has to decide before the request is overdue.
help.approval_reminderBeforeHours: Remind the approver this many hours before the deadline.

roles.fixedAdmin: The System Administrator always holds every permission. Its grants are defined by the system and cannot be edited.
roles.fixedCeo: The CEO always holds every business permission (no security administration). Its grants are defined by the system and cannot be edited.
